title: Closeness to a quadratic solution
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$ in $n$ variables, and let $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$. If a Boolean input $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ and a Boolean proof of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$ make the associated quadratic PCPP verifier accept with probability at least $1-\varepsilon/100000$, then there exists a Boolean input satisfying every equation in $L$ whose relative Hamming distance from $w$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations
